column1: # Reference cases for test/reference_harness.ml, shared by every runtime profile.
# Columns: function, exception rule, NaN rule, then one argument per parameter.
# The exception rule is quiet when the call must raise no invalid,
# divide-by-zero or overflow flag, and any otherwise. The NaN rule is exact when
# a NaN result must match the reference bit for bit, as bit casts, selections
# and strict reductions require, and nan-any where the language leaves a NaN
